description: M5 spectral check: the integrated early-photon objective and single-pass extraction of the five final designs at seven wavelengths across the LYSO emission band, Fourier order 7 (order check: <= 0.16 % from order 11), on the 18 x 4 optimisation grid. LYSO, grease and air keep their 420 nm indices (no dispersion source); Si3N4 is dispersive (Luke 2015).
